title: Juicy Baked Chicken Breasts
description: Simple oven-baked chicken breasts with a garlic-paprika rub, cooked hot and fast so they stay juicy. Great for meal prep.
equipment: Baking dish or rimmed baking sheet

image.alt: Golden baked chicken breasts sliced on a plate with herbs

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 425F oven}. If the breasts are very thick at one end, press or pound them to an even thickness so they cook evenly.
Rub the chicken with the oil. Mix the salt, paprika, garlic powder, oregano and pepper and sprinkle it evenly over both sides.
Lay the breasts in the baking dish with space between them. Bake until the thickest part reads {temp 160F internal}, {time 16-22 min} depending on size.
Cover loosely with foil and rest for {time 5 min}; the temperature rises to {temp 165F internal}. Slice and serve, or cool for meal prep.

notes: A thermometer is the surest way to avoid dry chicken; pull it out as soon as it’s done.
Cooked chicken keeps 4 days in the fridge; slice it for salads, wraps and grain bowls.
